# Reproducible Rendering Contract

## Outcome and Authority

TOOLS-D2 renders the canonical QMD into deterministic HTML, LaTeX, PDF, and
DOCX representations. Generated outputs are engineering records, not approval.
Only QMD may be corrected directly. Every output remains blocked from public
projection until semantic, page, accessibility, provenance, licensing, and
human-review gates owned by later subepics are complete.

The renderer uses the pinned command versions and inputs recorded in
`toolchain-lock.json`. It verifies the exact first version line before render,
expands only bounded QMD includes, uses the governed bibliography and reference
DOCX, disables TeX shell escape, normalizes volatile package metadata, and
binds every representation into `manifests/artifacts.json`. The command model
follows the documented Pandoc conversion contract [@pandoc-manual] while QMD
remains compatible with the pinned Quarto authoring surface [@quarto-guide].

![Deterministic rendering pathway.](figures/render-pipeline.png){width=80%}

## Semantic, Unit, and Warning Preservation

The semantic contract is deliberately format-neutral. Every representation
must retain the governed title, release boundary, representative unit string,
warning, figure label, and bibliography identity before receiving a shared
semantic digest. Example unit string: 10 m/s.

::: {.warning}
WARNING: Provisional calculations remain blocked.
:::

This gate proves preservation of required meaning across the four
representations. It does not prove calculation correctness, equation coverage,
accessibility, page aesthetics, or release approval. Missing text, a stale
digest, an unpinned tool, an unsafe include, or an absent artifact fails closed.

## Reproduction and Consumer Contract

Run `python -m scripts.render_tools_design_manual --verify-toolchain` before a
qualified build. Run `python -m scripts.render_tools_design_manual --render`
to replace renderer-owned artifacts, then
`python -m scripts.render_tools_design_manual --check` to validate source,
toolchain, byte, and semantic bindings. The strict JSON Schemas allow consumers
to validate the lock and manifest without importing producer code.

Artifact rows expose media type, byte count, byte digest, and shared semantic
digest. The manifest also preserves the owning epic, review owner, explicit
blockers, and a null immutable source commit while this local stack is not a
merged authority. A consumer must reject unknown fields, versions, formats,
paths, hashes, status promotion, or semantic divergence.
